subkind: five-year AI equipment leases (TPU racks, via Broadcom-arranged SPVs)
amount_text: ~$161.2B of non-cancelable five-year equipment leases with Broadcom per Anthropic's S-1 (26 Oct 2026), booked as finance leases; lessors are Broadcom-arranged SPVs financed by Apollo/Blackstone ($35B) and the $63B bank/Blackstone package (separate debt edges); may overlap with the 2025 Ironwood rack orders
term: Five-year leases, cancelable only on default
title_en: Anthropic's S-1 shows ~$161B of Broadcom chip-equipment leases
title_zh: Anthropic 招股书显示约 1612 亿美元博通芯片设备租赁
summary_en: Anthropic's IPO filing lists about $161.2B of five-year, non-cancelable leases of Broadcom-built AI equipment, its largest stated compute commitment, ahead of Google (~$114.5B) and Amazon (~$110B). The racks are bought by special-purpose vehicles funded with private credit and bank debt and leased to Anthropic, with Broadcom backstopping residual values.
summary_zh: Anthropic 的上市申请文件列出约 1612 亿美元、为期五年且不可撤销的博通 AI 设备租赁，是其披露的最大算力承诺，超过谷歌（约 1145 亿美元）和亚马逊（约 1100 亿美元）。这些机架由特殊目的实体以私募信贷和银行贷款购买后租给 Anthropic，博通为残值提供兜底。

amount_text: ~$40B binding commitment; Apollo-managed entity buys the chips and servers and leases them to SpaceX on ~5-5.25-year leases; closing expected by year-end 2026
term: Leases start H1 2027 as each tranche is delivered; ~5-5.25 years
title_en: SpaceX (xAI) signs $40B Apollo-led GPU lease financing
title_zh: SpaceX（xAI）签署阿波罗牵头的 400 亿美元 GPU 租赁融资
summary_en: SpaceX, xAI's parent, disclosed in a regulatory filing a binding commitment of about $40B under which an Apollo-managed entity buys Nvidia AI chips and data-centre equipment and leases them to SpaceX; it called it the largest committed GPU financing. The lessor funds itself with 144A notes; Bloomberg reported PIMCO bought a $4B slice of the A2 (mezzanine) tranche (its own edge, pimco-apollo-spacex-gpu-lessor-2026-10-a2-notes).
summary_zh: xAI 母公司 SpaceX 在监管文件中披露约 400 亿美元的有约束力承诺：由阿波罗管理的实体购买英伟达 AI 芯片和数据中心设备并租给 SpaceX，租期约 5 至 5.25 年，SpaceX 称其为最大的已承诺 GPU 融资。出租方通过 144A 票据融资；据彭博报道，PIMCO（品浩）认购了其中 A2（夹层）档 40 亿美元（另列为一条债务边）。

amount_text: $2.94B over 15 years (per Bloomberg, from the bond marketing)
title_en: CoreWeave 15-year, $2.94B lease of Richmond Digital Drive campus
title_zh: CoreWeave 以 29.4 亿美元租用里士满 Digital Drive 园区 15 年
summary_en: CoreWeave leases all 76 MW of IT capacity at the Digital Drive campus near Richmond, Virginia, under a 15-year contract worth $2.94B; its rent services the project's $1.1B junk bonds.
summary_zh: CoreWeave 以价值 29.4 亿美元的 15 年合同租下弗吉尼亚州里士满附近 Digital Drive 园区全部 76 兆瓦 IT 容量；租金用于偿付该项目 11 亿美元垃圾债。

amount_text: ~$9.1B expected contract revenue over 20 years to June 2048 (~$16.1B if both five-year extensions are exercised); tenant named by Bloomberg, not by Riot
term: 20 years; 96 MW from Dec 2027, full 191 MW from Jun 2028
title_en: Riot leases 191 MW at Rockdale to a frontier AI lab, reported to be Anthropic (~$9.1B)
title_zh: Riot 将 Rockdale 191 兆瓦租给前沿 AI 实验室（据报为 Anthropic，约 91 亿美元）
summary_en: Riot Platforms signed a 20-year lease of 191 MW of critical IT capacity at its Rockdale, Texas site with what it called a leading frontier AI lab, worth about $9.1 billion; Bloomberg reported the tenant is Anthropic. Morgan Stanley provides a $573 million interim loan for the build-out.
summary_zh: Riot Platforms 与一家“领先的前沿 AI 实验室”签订得州 Rockdale 园区 191 兆瓦关键 IT 容量、为期 20 年的租约，价值约 91 亿美元；彭博社报道租户为 Anthropic。摩根士丹利为建设提供 5.73 亿美元过桥贷款。

amount_text: ~$4.7B over the 16-year base term for 121 MW IT; ~$8.0B with an 8-year renewal; tenant may terminate without fee at year 10
title_en: Volta leases 121 MW at Bitdeer's Tydal, Norway campus (~$4.7B)
title_zh: Volta 租用 Bitdeer 挪威 Tydal 园区 121 兆瓦（约 47 亿美元）
summary_en: Volta, an NVIDIA Cloud Partner, signed a 16-year colocation lease for 121 MW of IT capacity at Bitdeer's Tydal campus in Norway, worth about $4.7B; Bitdeer says the end customer is a leading AI lab, which Bloomberg reported is Anthropic (not confirmed by the companies).
summary_zh: 英伟达云合作伙伴 Volta 与 Bitdeer 签订 16 年托管租约，租用其挪威 Tydal 园区 121 兆瓦 IT 容量，价值约 47 亿美元；Bitdeer 称最终客户为一家领先的 AI 实验室，彭博报道为 Anthropic（公司未证实）。

subkind: GPU and data-centre equipment SPV (usage fees)
amount_text: Brookfield to invest up to $9B (~KRW 12T) through an SPV ('Asset Co.') that owns the GPUs and data-centre equipment; NAVER Cloud pays usage-based fees (amount undisclosed, no committed total), guaranteed by Naver for up to 8 years; agreement signed 2026-10-27
term: GAK Sejong site 55 MW in H1 2027, 200 MW by 2028
title_en: Brookfield to fund up to $9B of compute for Naver's AI factory
title_zh: 布鲁克菲尔德为 NAVER AI 工厂提供最高 90 亿美元算力融资
summary_en: Naver disclosed on 27 October 2026 that it signed the agreement under which a Brookfield SPV, tentatively called Asset Co., invests up to $9B in GPUs and data centres for Naver's AI factory in Sejong and supplies the compute to NAVER Cloud for usage fees; Naver guarantees its subsidiary's fee obligations for up to eight years. The signing meets the condition for Nvidia's $1B investment in Naver.
summary_zh: NAVER 于 2026 年 10 月 27 日披露，已与布鲁克菲尔德签署协议：布鲁克菲尔德设立的特殊目的实体（暂名 Asset Co.）投入最高 90 亿美元（约 12 万亿韩元）购置 GPU 和数据中心，为 NAVER 位于世宗的 AI 工厂提供算力，由 NAVER Cloud 按使用量付费；NAVER 为子公司的付费义务提供最长八年的担保。此次签约满足了英伟达向 NAVER 投资 10 亿美元的前提条件。

to_name: Sopaipilla Investor LLC (Meta El Paso JV)
amount_text: Rent undisclosed
title_en: Meta leases El Paso campus from BlackRock JV
title_zh: Meta 向贝莱德合资公司租用埃尔帕索园区
summary_en: Meta is the developer, operator and sole tenant of the El Paso campus owned by the Sopaipilla joint venture; its lease payments service the SPV bonds.
summary_zh: Meta 是 Sopaipilla 合资公司所持埃尔帕索园区的开发商、运营商和唯一租户，其租金用于偿付该 SPV 的债券。

amount_text: ~$9.8B base contract value over the 15-year initial term for 352 MW critical IT (Beacon Point Phase 2); up to ~$25.1B with three 5-year renewals; campus total $19.6B base / ~$50.2B with renewals; tenant named by the FT, not by Hut 8
title_en: Hut 8's second 352 MW Beacon Point lease, same tenant reported to be NVIDIA (~$9.8B)
title_zh: Hut 8 签订 Beacon Point 第二份 352 兆瓦租约，同一租户据报为英伟达（约 98 亿美元）
summary_en: Hut 8 signed a second 15-year lease with the same high-investment-grade tenant for another 352 MW of critical IT capacity at Beacon Point, Texas, worth about $9.8 billion and fully contracting the ~1 GW campus ($19.6 billion across both leases); the Financial Times reported the tenant is NVIDIA, which has not confirmed it. Delivery is expected from Q2 2028.
summary_zh: Hut 8 与同一家高投资级租户再签一份 15 年租约，出租得州 Beacon Point 园区另外 352 兆瓦关键 IT 容量，价值约 98 亿美元，使约 1 吉瓦的园区全部签约（两份租约合计 196 亿美元）；《金融时报》报道租户为英伟达，英伟达未予证实。预计 2028 年二季度起交付。

amount_text: ~$19B of contracted lease revenue over a 20-year initial term (value with extensions not disclosed)
term: 20-year initial term; first capacity 2H 2027, full 401 MW by early 2028
title_en: Anthropic leases ~401 MW at TeraWulf's Kentucky campus (~$19B)
title_zh: Anthropic 租用 TeraWulf 肯塔基园区约 401 兆瓦（约 190 亿美元）
summary_en: TeraWulf signed a 20-year lease with Anthropic for about 401 MW of critical IT load at the Justified Data campus in Hawesville, Kentucky, worth about $19 billion over the initial term. First capacity is due in the second half of 2027, the full 401 MW by early 2028.
summary_zh: TeraWulf 与 Anthropic 签订为期 20 年的租约，出租肯塔基州 Hawesville 的 Justified Data 园区约 401 兆瓦关键 IT 负载，初始期限内租金收入约 190 亿美元；首批容量 2027 年下半年交付，2028 年初全部 401 兆瓦到位。

amount_text: ~$9.8B base contract value over the 15-year initial term for 352 MW critical IT (Beacon Point Phase 1); up to ~$25B with three 5-year renewals; tenant named by the FT, not by Hut 8
title_en: Hut 8 leases 352 MW at Beacon Point to an investment-grade tenant, reported to be NVIDIA (~$9.8B)
title_zh: Hut 8 将 Beacon Point 352 兆瓦租给投资级租户（据报为英伟达，约 98 亿美元）
summary_en: Hut 8 signed a 15-year triple-net lease for 352 MW of critical IT capacity in Phase 1 of its Beacon Point campus in Nueces County, Texas, worth about $9.8 billion, with what it called a high-investment-grade technology company; the Financial Times reported in July that the tenant is NVIDIA (not confirmed by the companies). The build is financed by $4.25 billion of notes (separate edge).
summary_zh: Hut 8 与一家“高投资级科技公司”签订为期 15 年的三净租约，出租其得州纽埃塞斯县 Beacon Point 园区一期 352 兆瓦关键 IT 容量，价值约 98 亿美元；英国《金融时报》7 月报道租户为英伟达（公司未证实）。建设资金来自 42.5 亿美元票据（另列）。

subkind: hardware lease of AI systems with warrant
amount_text: Not disclosed; multi-year lease of Cerebras systems in AWS data centres with options for further purchases; Cerebras issued AWS a warrant for up to 2,696,678 shares at $100, vesting with AWS payments
term: initial multi-year lease (agreement signed June 2026; not yet commenced at 30 June 2026)
title_en: AWS lease of Cerebras AI systems, with a Cerebras warrant
title_zh: AWS 租用 Cerebras AI 系统（附 Cerebras 认股权证）
summary_en: Amazon and Cerebras announced in March 2026 a joint inference service pairing AWS Trainium3 with Cerebras systems inside AWS data centres; in June 2026 they signed a global hardware leasing agreement with exclusivity and minimum manufacturing capacity guarantees for AWS. Cerebras issued Amazon a warrant for up to about 2.7 million shares at $100, vesting as AWS payments reach set thresholds; the value was not disclosed.
summary_zh: 亚马逊与 Cerebras 于 2026 年 3 月宣布在 AWS 数据中心内将 Trainium3 与 Cerebras 系统结合提供推理服务；2026 年 6 月双方签署全球硬件租赁协议，包含对 AWS 的排他条款和最低产能保证。Cerebras 向亚马逊发行认股权证，可按每股 100 美元认购最多约 270 万股，随 AWS 付款达到门槛分批归属；金额未披露。

amount_text: ~$2.0B contracted lease payments over the 15-year base term (~$5.7B if three 5-year extensions are exercised); 70 MW critical IT (100 MW gross); signed March 2026 (day not disclosed), tenant named 2026-06-08
title_en: AWS leases Cipher's 70 MW Stingray data centre in Texas (~$2.0B)
title_zh: AWS 租用 Cipher 得州 Stingray 70 兆瓦数据中心（约 20 亿美元）
summary_en: Amazon Data Services (AWS) signed a 15-year triple-net lease for 70 MW of critical IT capacity at Cipher Digital's Stingray site in Andrews, Texas, worth about $2.0 billion in base rent, with rent from April 2027; Amazon.com guarantees the rent and covers construction cost overruns above a cap. It is Cipher's second AWS lease after Black Pearl.
summary_zh: 亚马逊数据服务公司（AWS）与 Cipher Digital 签订为期 15 年的三净租约，租用其得州安德鲁斯 Stingray 园区 70 兆瓦关键 IT 容量，基础租金约 20 亿美元，2027 年 4 月起计租；亚马逊母公司为租金提供担保，并承担超出上限的建设成本。这是继 Black Pearl 之后 Cipher 与 AWS 的第二份租约。

amount_text: ~$636M total contract revenue over the 10-year initial terms for 50 MW ($311M for the first 25 MW signed Jan 2026 + $325M for a 25 MW expansion option exercised in Q1 2026); three 5-year extensions; AMD holds options for up to 150 MW more
term: 10 years (three 5-year extension options); 25 MW from May 2026, 50 MW by May 2027
title_en: AMD leases 50 MW at Riot's Rockdale site (~$636M)
title_zh: AMD 租用 Riot Rockdale 园区 50 兆瓦（约 6.36 亿美元）
summary_en: AMD signed Riot Platforms' first data-centre lease, for 25 MW of critical IT capacity at Rockdale, Texas (~$311 million over 10 years), and in Q1 2026 exercised an expansion option for another 25 MW, taking the lease to 50 MW and about $636 million. AMD keeps options for up to 150 MW more.
summary_zh: AMD 与 Riot Platforms 签订其首份数据中心租约，租用得州 Rockdale 园区 25 兆瓦关键 IT 容量（10 年约 3.11 亿美元）；2026 年一季度 AMD 行使扩容选择权再增 25 兆瓦，租约增至 50 兆瓦、约 6.36 亿美元，并保留最多再增 150 兆瓦的选择权。

amount_text: Rent undisclosed; covers ~$5.4B of compute incl. Nvidia GB200
title_en: xAI leases Nvidia GPUs from Valor vehicle
title_zh: xAI 向 Valor 特殊目的实体租用英伟达 GPU
summary_en: An xAI subsidiary leases the GPUs owned by Valor Compute Infrastructure on a triple-net basis for Grok training at its Memphis site; lenders are repaid from the lease, secured by the chips.
summary_zh: xAI 子公司以三重净租赁方式租用 Valor Compute Infrastructure 持有的 GPU，用于孟菲斯基地的 Grok 训练；贷款以芯片为抵押，由租金偿付。

amount_text: $7.0B base-term contract value for 245 MW; up to ~$17.7B with three 5-year renewals; ROFO on up to 1,000 MW more
title_en: Fluidstack leases 245 MW at Hut 8's River Bend campus ($7B)
title_zh: Fluidstack 租用 Hut 8 River Bend 园区 245 兆瓦（70 亿美元）
summary_en: Fluidstack signed a 15-year, $7.0B triple-net lease for 245 MW at Hut 8's River Bend campus in Louisiana, part of a partnership in which Hut 8 develops capacity for Anthropic on clusters operated by Fluidstack; Google backstops the lease payments (separate edge).
summary_zh: Fluidstack 与 Hut 8 签订 15 年、70 亿美元的三净租约，租用其路易斯安那州 River Bend 园区 245 兆瓦；这是 Hut 8 为 Anthropic 开发、由 Fluidstack 运营算力集群的合作的一部分，谷歌为租金提供兜底（另列一条）。

amount_text: ~$5.5B over 15 years for 300 MW; rent starts August 2026
term: 15 years; capacity delivered in two phases, July to Q4 2026
title_en: AWS signs $5.5B, 15-year lease with Cipher Mining
title_zh: AWS 与 Cipher Mining 签订 55 亿美元 15 年租约
summary_en: Amazon Web Services agreed to lease 300 MW of air- and liquid-cooled data-centre capacity from bitcoin miner Cipher Mining for about $5.5B over 15 years, with delivery during 2026.
summary_zh: AWS 同意以约 55 亿美元、为期 15 年的条件，向比特币矿企 Cipher Mining 租用 300 兆瓦风冷和液冷数据中心容量，2026 年内交付。

amount_text: ~$9.5B contracted revenue to the joint venture over a 25-year term for 168 MW critical IT (240 MW gross); term may be shortened to 20 or 15 years
title_en: Fluidstack leases TeraWulf's 168 MW Abernathy JV campus (~$9.5B)
title_zh: Fluidstack 租用 TeraWulf 合资的 Abernathy 168 兆瓦园区（约 95 亿美元）
summary_en: TeraWulf and Fluidstack formed a joint venture (TeraWulf 50.1%) to build a 168 MW AI campus in Abernathy, Texas, fully leased to Fluidstack for 25 years for about $9.5 billion, serving a frontier AI model developer; Google backs $1.3 billion of the lease (separate edge). In July 2026 TeraWulf agreed to sell its whole JV stake to Fluidstack and other buyers for about $530 million.
summary_zh: TeraWulf 与 Fluidstack 成立合资公司（TeraWulf 持股 50.1%），在得州 Abernathy 建设 168 兆瓦 AI 园区，由 Fluidstack 整体租用 25 年，合同收入约 95 亿美元，服务一家前沿大模型开发商；谷歌为其中 13 亿美元租金提供兜底（另列）。2026 年 7 月 TeraWulf 同意以约 5.3 亿美元将所持合资股权全部出售给 Fluidstack 等买方。

amount_text: ~$5B total contracted revenue over ~15 years for 200 MW; right of first refusal on a further 800 MW
title_en: Oracle leases 200 MW at Applied Digital's Polaris Forge 2 (~$5B)
title_zh: 甲骨文租用 Applied Digital Polaris Forge 2 园区 200 兆瓦（约 50 亿美元）
summary_en: Applied Digital signed a ~15-year, ~$5B lease for 200 MW at its Polaris Forge 2 campus in Harwood, North Dakota, with a then-unnamed investment-grade hyperscaler; its March 2026 8-K says the campus is leased to Oracle. The tenant holds a right of first refusal on another 800 MW.
summary_zh: Applied Digital 与一家当时未具名的投资级超大规模云厂商签订约 15 年、约 50 亿美元租约，出租北达科他州哈伍德 Polaris Forge 2 园区 200 兆瓦；其 2026 年 3 月 8-K 文件披露该园区租户为甲骨文。租户对另外 800 兆瓦拥有优先承租权。

amount_text: Rent undisclosed; ~$27B campus development cost; Meta can exit at 4-year intervals
title_en: Meta leases Hyperion campus from Blue Owl JV
title_zh: Meta 向 Blue Owl 合资公司租用 Hyperion 园区
summary_en: Meta leases the Hyperion campus back from the Beignet joint venture; its rent services the $27.3B of bonds. Short renewable terms keep the obligation off Meta's balance sheet.
summary_zh: Meta 从 Beignet 合资公司回租 Hyperion 园区，其租金用于偿付 273 亿美元债券；较短的可续租期使该义务不计入 Meta 资产负债表。

amount_text: ~$3.8B contracted revenue over initial 10-year terms: ~$3B for 168 MW (Sept 2025) + ~$830M for 56 MW (Nov 2025); ~$9B with two 5-year extensions
title_en: Fluidstack leases 224 MW at Cipher's Barber Lake (~$3.8B)
title_zh: Fluidstack 租用 Cipher Barber Lake 园区 224 兆瓦（约 38 亿美元）
summary_en: Fluidstack signed a 10-year, 168 MW AI hosting lease at Cipher Mining's Barber Lake site in Texas (~$3B) and added 56 MW in November 2025 (~$830M), ~$3.8B in all over the initial term. Google backstops $1.73B of the lease payments (separate edge).
summary_zh: Fluidstack 与 Cipher Mining 签订得州 Barber Lake 园区 168 兆瓦、为期 10 年的 AI 托管租约（约 30 亿美元），2025 年 11 月再追加 56 兆瓦（约 8.3 亿美元），初始期限合同收入合计约 38 亿美元；谷歌为其中 17.3 亿美元租金提供兜底（另列一条）。

amount_text: ~$1.5B over 4 years for ~18,000 GPUs ($1.3B for 10,000 + $200M for 8,000)
title_en: Nvidia leases back its own GPUs from Lambda (~$1.5B)
title_zh: 英伟达向 Lambda 回租自家 GPU（约 15 亿美元）
summary_en: The Information reported that Nvidia, an investor in Lambda, will rent about 18,000 GPU servers back from Lambda over four years for roughly $1.5B, making it Lambda's biggest customer; Lambda raised a ~$917M loan to buy the chips.
summary_zh: 据 The Information 报道，作为 Lambda 投资方的英伟达将在四年内以约 15 亿美元回租约 1.8 万台 GPU 服务器，成为 Lambda 最大客户；Lambda 为购买这些芯片筹集了约 9.17 亿美元贷款。

amount_text: ~$4.0B over an initial ~15-year term for 150 MW (third building, ELN-04); brings CoreWeave's Polaris Forge 1 leases to 400 MW and ~$11B
title_en: CoreWeave leases a further 150 MW at Polaris Forge 1 (~$4B)
title_zh: CoreWeave 追加租用 Polaris Forge 1 园区 150 兆瓦（约 40 亿美元）
summary_en: CoreWeave exercised its option and signed a third ~15-year lease for 150 MW at Applied Digital's Polaris Forge 1 campus, worth about $4B, taking the whole 400 MW campus and about $11B of contracted rent. The building is funded by Applied Digital's $1.59B 2031 notes (separate edge).
summary_zh: CoreWeave 行使选择权，与 Applied Digital 签订第三份约 15 年期租约，追加租用 Polaris Forge 1 园区 150 兆瓦，价值约 40 亿美元，使其包下整个 400 兆瓦园区、合同租金合计约 110 亿美元。该栋楼由 Applied Digital 发行的 15.9 亿美元 2031 年到期票据出资（另列一条）。

amount_text: ~$6.7B contracted revenue over initial 10-year terms for CB-3, CB-4 and CB-5 (~$3.7B for the first ~200 MW, then +160 MW CB-5); up to ~$16B with extensions; July 2026 amendments raised CB-4 and CB-5 to 168 MW each (value not updated)
title_en: Fluidstack leases 360 MW at TeraWulf's Lake Mariner (~$6.7B)
title_zh: Fluidstack 租用 TeraWulf Lake Mariner 园区 360 兆瓦（约 67 亿美元）
summary_en: Fluidstack signed 10-year leases for AI data halls at TeraWulf's Lake Mariner campus in New York, first ~200 MW (CB-3/CB-4, ~$3.7B) and then CB-5 (+160 MW), for ~$6.7B of contracted revenue. Google backstops up to $3.2B of the lease payments (separate edge).
summary_zh: Fluidstack 与 TeraWulf 签订纽约 Lake Mariner 园区 AI 数据机房 10 年租约，先是约 200 兆瓦（CB-3/CB-4，约 37 亿美元），后追加 CB-5（160 兆瓦），合同收入合计约 67 亿美元；谷歌为其中最多 32 亿美元租金提供兜底（另列一条）。

amount_text: ~$7B total revenue over ~15 years for 250 MW of critical IT load (two leases, ELN-02 100 MW and ELN-03 150 MW)
title_en: CoreWeave leases 250 MW at Applied Digital's Polaris Forge 1 (~$7B)
title_zh: CoreWeave 租用 Applied Digital Polaris Forge 1 园区 250 兆瓦（约 70 亿美元）
summary_en: CoreWeave signed two ~15-year leases for 250 MW of critical IT load at Applied Digital's Polaris Forge 1 campus in Ellendale, North Dakota, worth about $7B in total. CoreWeave also took an option on a further 150 MW, which it later exercised (separate edge).
summary_zh: CoreWeave 与 Applied Digital 签订两份约 15 年期租约，租用其北达科他州埃伦代尔 Polaris Forge 1 园区 250 兆瓦关键 IT 负载，总收入约 70 亿美元；CoreWeave 还获得追加 150 兆瓦的选择权，后已行使（另列一条）。

amount_text: Undisclosed total; Galaxy expects >$1B average annual revenue over the 15-year terms for 526 MW of critical IT load (133 MW Phase I, 260 MW Phase II, 133 MW Phase III)
title_en: CoreWeave leases all 526 MW at Galaxy's Helios campus
title_zh: CoreWeave 租下 Galaxy Helios 园区全部 526 兆瓦
summary_en: CoreWeave leased the first 133 MW at Galaxy's Helios campus in Dickens County, Texas, in March 2025 and then exercised its options for 260 MW and the final 133 MW, taking all 526 MW of critical IT load; Galaxy expects more than $1B of average annual revenue. Phase I was delivered in July 2026.
summary_zh: CoreWeave 于 2025 年 3 月租用 Galaxy 位于得州迪肯斯县 Helios 园区的首期 133 兆瓦，随后行使选择权追加 260 兆瓦及最后 133 兆瓦，包下全部 526 兆瓦关键 IT 负载；Galaxy 预计年均收入超过 10 亿美元。一期已于 2026 年 7 月交付。
